title: HeartBEAM: Older Adult Resting State and Auditory Oddball Task EEG Data
description: This dataset comprises resting-state and auditory oddball task electroencephalography (EEG) recordings from older adults under two experimental conditions: control and threat-of-shock arousal. Participants completed eyes-open and eyes-closed resting periods, as well as passive and active auditory oddball tasks with standard, target, and distractor tones. The data were collected as part of the HeartBEAM study investigating locus coeruleus-noradrenaline system function and its relationship to attention and memory in aging.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired during resting-state conditions (eyes open and eyes closed, 5 minutes each) and auditory oddball tasks (passive and active variants) under control and threat-of-shock conditions. Event markers indicate task phases, stimulus types (standard, target, distractor tones), and behavioral responses.
